label: Personality · IPIP-NEO-120
title: IPIP-NEO-120 · 30 facets

license.attribution: International Personality Item Pool (IPIP). Public-domain items and scoring keys.

source.citation: Johnson, J. A. (2014). Measuring thirty facets of the Five Factor Model with a 120-item public domain inventory: Development of the IPIP-NEO-120. Journal of Research in Personality, 51, 78–89. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jrp.2014.05.003 Item order checked against the numbered English column at https://ipip.ori.org/ItalianIPIP-NEO-120.htm; English facet-key wording retained for item 58.
source.limits: Raw trait means, not percentiles or clinical cutoffs. NEO-PI-R is a separate proprietary inventory. No diagnosis, forensic norms or combined total; political-attitude items retain the original US wording.

stem: Describe yourself as you generally are now. Indicate how accurately each statement describes you.
